headline: Growth is running hot and inflation is re-accelerating: Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3% and October core PCE rose to 3.3%, which keeps the Dec 9 hike (priced at roughly 90%+) firmly on track and raises the risk of more in 2027. Keep hurdle rates anchored to a ~4.9% 10-year plus 25–50 bp of expected policy tightening, and budget wide high-yield spreads (~360 bp, off Friday's peak but still volatile) on any levered financing. Energy remains the main relief, with WTI near $82 and Brent near $91, well below early-November levels.
